statusHint.OPEN: We've got your message. A member of our support team will pick it up soon.
statusHint.IN_PROGRESS: A team member is working on it. We'll write here as soon as we have news.
statusHint.WAITING_FOR_USER: We need a little more information from you. Please reply below so we can continue.
statusHint.RESOLVED: We think this is sorted. Tell us if it helped — or reply below if you still need help and we'll reopen it.
statusHint.CLOSED: This ticket is closed. If you need more help, you're welcome to open a new one.

LISTING_PROBLEM.label: Listing problem
LISTING_PROBLEM.hint: Something is wrong with a listing — yours or someone else's.

SCAM_REPORT.label: Report a scam
SCAM_REPORT.hint: Someone asked for money up front, or a listing looks fake.

ACCOUNT_VERIFICATION.label: Account or verification
ACCOUNT_VERIFICATION.hint: Signing in, your profile, ID or ownership checks.

TECHNICAL.label: Technical problem
TECHNICAL.hint: A page, button or upload isn't working as it should.

PAYMENT.label: Payment
PAYMENT.hint: Questions about paid features and receipts.

OTHER.label: Other
OTHER.hint: Anything else — ideas and feedback are welcome too.

messages.internalNote: Internal note — the user can't see this

screenshots.tooMany: You can attach up to {max} screenshots.

form.categoryHint: Choosing the right topic gets your ticket to the right person faster.

scam.title: Your safety comes first
scam.stopPaying: Don't send any more money and stop sharing personal details with this person.
scam.bank: If you already paid, contact your bank or payment app right away — they can sometimes stop the transfer.
scam.evidence: Add the listing link and screenshots of the chat and of any payment request.
scam.danger: If you are in danger, call the local emergency number (112 in Georgia).

form.subject: Subject
form.subjectPlaceholder: For example: the owner asked for a deposit by bank transfer
form.messagePlaceholder: What happened, when, and what have you already tried?
form.messageHint: Write in any language you like. Please don't share passwords or card numbers.
form.listingPlaceholder: 1234 or a link to the listing
form.listingHint: Paste the listing number (shown as “ID” on the listing) or its link.
form.screenshotsHint: Up to {max} images, for example a chat or an error message. They're stored encrypted and only our support team can see them.
form.privacy: Only you and our support team can see this ticket.

errors.not_rateable: This ticket can be rated once it's marked as resolved.

errors.invalid_assignee: This team member can't be assigned to support tickets.

shabbat.title: Support is resting for Shabbat
shabbat.body: New tickets and replies are paused for Shabbat and holidays. You can keep reading the help center — please write to us after Shabbat ends. Shabbat Shalom!
shabbat.urgent: If you are in danger, call the local emergency number (112 in Georgia). Safety advice is always available in the <safety>Safety Center</safety>.

newPage.title: Open a support ticket
newPage.lead: Tell us what happened and we'll answer here and by email. Scam reports are handled first.

tips.listingId: The listing number or link, if it's about a listing.
tips.screenshots: Screenshots of the chat, the error or the payment request.
tips.steps: What you did, what you expected and what happened instead.

newPage.scamBody: Never pay before you've checked the owner and seen the place, in person or on a live video call.
newPage.updatesEmail: We'll email you every time we reply. You can also follow everything in “My tickets”.
newPage.updatesNoEmail: Your account has no email address, so you'll find our replies in “My tickets”. Add an email in your settings to get updates by email too.

listPage.title: My support tickets
listPage.lead: Every conversation with our support team, newest first.
listPage.emptyBody: When you ask our support team for help, the conversation will appear here. Many answers are already in the help center.
listPage.waitingNotice: {count, plural, one {One ticket is waiting for your reply.} other {{countText} tickets are waiting for your reply.}}

detail.metaDescription: Your conversation with our support team.
detail.closedOn: Closed on {date}. If you need more help, open a new ticket.
detail.closedBody: If you need more help, open a new ticket.
detail.ratedLabel: You rated our help {rating} out of 5.
detail.createdToastBody: We'll reply here and let you know by email.

reply.title: Write a reply
reply.reopenHint: Sending a reply puts your ticket back in our queue.
reply.label: Your message
reply.placeholder: Write your answer or add more details…

rating.title: Was this helpful?
rating.lead: Rate our help from 1 to 5 stars. It takes a second and helps us get better.
rating.commentPlaceholder: What went well, and what could we do better?
rating.closesNote: Sending your rating closes the ticket.

close.title: Close this ticket?
close.body: Close it if your problem is solved. You won't be able to reply afterwards, but you can always open a new ticket.

loadError.title: We couldn't load this page
loadError.body: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.

notFound.title: We couldn't find this ticket
notFound.body: It may belong to another account, or the link is incomplete. All your tickets are in “My tickets”.
